Campus Customs: the three resolved tickets

Homework 5, Problem 9. Shop business date 2026-08-31. Generated 2026-10-11 by scripts/build_p9_evidence.py from the recorded evidence; the screenshots are the unedited final-state captures.

What "resolved" means here

Two requirement statements apply. Problem 7: Do not automatically mark a ticket resolved merely because the agent run finishes. Problem 8 (summary): the dashboard marks tickets resolved when runs finish. Our dashboard does not resolve a ticket automatically. When a run finishes it shows the human steps, and a person resolves the ticket by stating exactly what they confirm. There are two resolution types:

  • Business outcome confirmed The person confirmed that the underlying business issue is resolved (ticket 102: the rent was paid through the human approval path).
  • Simulated workflow complete; fulfilment not verified The person confirmed only that the desk's work in this simulation is complete: agents ran, every proposal was decided, messages were drafted. The listed outcomes are not verified (tickets 101 and 103).

The simulation cannot record physical fulfilment: the shop date never advances (R5) and messages are never sent (R7). Nothing on this page claims that goods were delivered or that a customer accepted anything.
